Recipes (Python means the standard-library runtime, not the unavailable Windows
Store alias on this host):

```powershell
python tools/verify_bundle.py
python tools/lift_hce.py
cargo fmt
python tools/capture_hce.py --suite tests/fixtures/hce-oracle-fens.json --out work/hce-oracle-target-state
python tools/capture_hce.py --suite work/hce-expanded-fens.json --out work/hce-oracle-expanded --limit 512
python tools/hce_fixtures.py --capture work/hce-oracle-expanded/capture.json --out tests/fixtures/hce-native-expanded.tsv
cargo test
cargo test --release
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo fmt --check
```

Directed raw captures: work/hce-oracle-initial and
work/hce-oracle-target-state. Expanded raw capture: work/hce-oracle-expanded.
Frozen consumed inputs are tests/fixtures/hce-native.tsv and
tests/fixtures/hce-native-expanded.tsv; the latter includes a native root-state
snapshot as well as the exact evaluator inputs. Each fixture header names the
original hash and expanded capture hash. assets/provenance.json records every
embedded section's original VA, file offset, size and SHA-256.

Calibration: the first directed capture initialized the previous search on the
opposite side; the UCI parser retained that side's scratch tempo. That observation
corrected the capture setup before freezing accepted fixtures. No discrepant
scores were normalized away. Both initial and corrected captures are retained.
The parser also clears material adjustment on its final position rebuild;
snapshot parity and normal root preparation are checked as separate layers.

Material limitations: address-linked Rust is the first reconstruction form;
complete semantic table naming and nondefault option qualification are open.
Static corpus equality is not proof over all possible positions, original search
equivalence, CPU/performance parity or Elo. Rarog's own search policy remains
active. No commits or pushes per the maintainer's instruction.
